scope: Every Python and Cython function recursively under rmgpy and arkane, including methods, callbacks, lambdas and property accessors. Conservative superset of all scientific suppliers and their transitive helpers. Numerical carried sites operate on explicitly supplied models or the original supplied molecular structure; resolved thermo acquisition supplies state-matched data to arithmetic helpers; administrative non-acquisition helpers are not-reachable-for-resolved acquisition, not a promise that generic utilities reject state-bearing arguments. No verdict is inferred by the production census.
